newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Cariverona lowers prime rate to 10.50 pct.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Cariverona lowers prime rate to 10.50 pct.

text.p: Italy's Cassa di Risparmio di Verona, Vicenza, Belluno e Ancona Banca Spa said it would lower its prime rate 10.50 percent from 11.25 percent, with effect from November 1.
The savings bank said its top rate for clients would be cut to 17.75 percent from 18.5 percent.
The move follows a reduction on Wednesday evening in the Bank of Italy's discount rate to 7.50 percent from 8.25 percent.
So far Monte dei Paschi di Siena has been the only major commercial bank to announce a cut in its prime rate. It said it was cutting the rate to 10 percent from 10.75 percent.
